design.transformer: from-scratch tiny temporal Transformer encoder (d_model=32, 2 layers, 2 heads, L=60 daily seq), predicts P(next 21-trading-day KOSPI200 index return < 0) from 11 market-priced daily features (KOSPI ret/vol/mom + VIX/Term_Spread/KRW/US2Y/US10Y/StL_FinStress/Chi_FinCond).
design.walk_forward: expanding-window annual refit; training pairs require label fully realized before year boundary; per-refit standardization frozen on training window; internal val = last ~12mo (IS-only); score seq ends strictly before holding-month start.
design.exposure_mapping: IS-calibrated threshold matched to incumbent M4 firing frequency (0.126) and depth (0.70) — isolates TIMING quality, not de-risk budget. 2-tier variant gave identical result.
design.oos_window: 2008-2026 (2008 GFC is genuine OOS: initial model trained only on 2000-2007)

book_delta_treat_vs_base.interpretation: Transformer detector is WORSE on the book objective (SR, CAGR, calmar) and no better on MDD. PORT_t marginally higher (+0.08) but PORT_t is active-t, not the overlay's calmar/MDD objective.

paired_nw_t_lag3.conclusion: No statistically distinguishable improvement; sign is negative both for the full overlay swap and the isolated detector.

pit_three_tests.assert_overlay_pit: PASS — all TF feature cutoffs strictly < holding-month start (0/221 violations); python self-check 0/221 last_feat_date >= decision_date

strict_pit_ab_loose_vs_strict.verdict: CLEAN — loose(look-ahead) ≈ strict; no exploitable same-month information → the negative is genuine, not a faith-bug

lag1_stress.verdict: NO COLLAPSE (improves marginally) — confirms (a) no same-month leakage, (b) signal carries ~no genuine month-specific timing content (staleness does not hurt)

ax001_v2_crisis_conditional.conclusion: TF marginally WORSE at cushioning crises than M4; the crisis cushion in treatment comes from the shared AR x R05 layers, not the TF detector. No crisis-defense improvement.

mechanism.firing_pattern: TF fired (de-risk) 30/221 months but ANTI-correlated with real crises: MISSED 2008 GFC (p_bad 0.61<tau 0.66), 2011 Euro (p_bad 0.29), 2018-10 selloff (0.50), COVID 2020-02/03 (p_bad 0.33/0.27 — its LOWEST readings), 2022 (0.41); instead fired during the 2017 BULL market and 2023 recovery.
mechanism.root_cause: Supervised learned timing requires in-sample analogs of the regime being predicted. Crashes are rare, out-of-distribution events; a symmetric down-month classifier overfits benign macro-feature configurations that historically preceded mild down months, and stays fully invested into unprecedented crises. M4 BOCPD is UNSUPERVISED change-point detection — it flags structural breaks in real time regardless of training analogs, which is structurally better-suited for a de-risking overlay.
mechanism.capacity_rebuttal: Not an under-training artifact: the model fired CONFIDENTLY at the wrong times (2017 bull) and stayed long into COVID. That is a wrong-signal problem, not a weak-signal problem; more capacity deepens the overfit to seen benign regimes rather than improving extrapolation to unseen crises.

production_parity.status: EXACT (ym-join to build_overlay_exposure native) — incumbent base validated against production code

next_probes: NP1 (root-cause-targeted): UNSUPERVISED sequence model — transformer autoencoder reconstruction-error / sequence anomaly score as a learned change-point detector, preserving M4's unsupervised advantage while adding path modeling. Directly attacks the identified failure (supervised needs analogs; unsupervised does not).
NP2: pretrained TS foundation-model regime prior (FQ-061, capacity-gated, separate track) — broad cross-regime priors may extrapolate to unseen crises better than from-scratch supervised.

NP3: asymmetric/crash-specific label (forward max-drawdown or tail-loss > threshold) instead of symmetric down-month — the overlay cares about tails; caveat: the supervised-rarity problem (few crash labels) persists and may not resolve the OOD extrapolation issue.

consumption.overlay_frontier: from-scratch SUPERVISED transformer timing detector = settled-negative for detector-swap; M4 BOCPD retains incumbent role. Route to DIST (overlay_regime family).
consumption.reusable_lesson: KR overlay layer: supervised learned timing detectors fail at unseen crisis onsets; unsupervised change-point (M4) structurally superior for de-risk overlays.
